environments.description: The interior of an orcish blacksmith's forge: a roaring stone furnace glowing orange on the back wall, racks of crude axes and shields, hanging tongs and chains, a leather bellows, a quench barrel, soot-dark stone walls and a packed-dirt floor lit by ember glow.

An outdoor Japanese hot spring in winter at blue dusk: a steaming rock-edged pool across the lower middle, snow-dusted boulders, a bamboo fence, a glowing stone lantern, pine branches heavy with snow, drifting steam.
A sweet pastel bakery kitchen: pink-and-cream checkered floor, a back counter with cake stands and cupcakes, a window with bunting, shelves of jars, a stand mixer, soft pink light.

A cluttered 1980s robotics garage workshop: a pegboard wall of tools, a shelf of half-built robot heads and gears, an oscilloscope showing a green waveform, a hanging work lamp, coiled cables on a concrete floor, blueprint posters.

The wooden deck of a fantasy airship at sunset: railings and rigging at the sides, a huge billowing sail in the distance, orange-pink clouds below, a ship's wheel at the back, polished brass fittings.

A quiet riverbank at golden dusk: a slow stream across the foreground with lily pads and reeds, a small wooden footbridge in the background, drifting fireflies, soft mist, mossy stones and distant hills.

The inside of a large glass desert terrarium seen from the front: sandy substrate, stacked rocks and driftwood at the sides, a glowing heat lamp hanging at the top casting a warm cone of light, a water dish, small succulents, amber light.

A smoky 1950s jazz club stage: a dark red curtain backdrop, a small round stage lit by a spotlight pool, stand-up bass and drum-kit silhouettes at the sides, cafe tables with candles at the bottom edges, a warm blue-purple haze.

A moonlit composer's attic studio: an upright piano on one side, sheet music scattered and pinned to the walls, a candle in a brass holder, a metronome on a shelf, a round window with a night sky, wooden floorboards.

A 1990s kid's bedroom desk corner: a corkboard covered in posters, a glowing lava lamp, a stack of game boxes, a chunky CRT TV, a bean bag, blue-green evening light through window blinds, a carpeted floor.
